page: Microsoft Azure L160iaos_v5 is an isolated virtual machine instance from the Laosv5 family, powered by AMD processors with x86_64 architecture. It features 160 dedicated vCPUs and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 1055.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.59 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of the L160iaos_v5 is its massive local storage capacity of 138239 GB. The instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance disk configurations. It does not include integrated GPU hardware, meaning all workloads rely entirely on the 160 dedicated x86_64 CPU cores. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance.

Given the combination of 160 dedicated vCPUs, over 1 TB of RAM, and exceptionally large local storage, this instance is designed for high-density storage workloads, large-scale databases, and big data analytics. The isolated hardware profile provides dedicated resource allocation, making it suitable for enterprise applications requiring strict performance guarantees and high resource density.
